title: 高盛CEO接班安排浮现 沃尔德伦或提前接任
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Now, over on Wall Street, Goldman Sachs, John Waldron, may get his shot at CEO sooner.
segments.zh: 在华尔街，高盛的约翰·沃尔德伦可能更快有机会出任CEO。

segments.en: Rather than later, the Wall Street Journal reporting the board has discussed a plan where Waldron, 16, stayed with Solomon as early as next year, joining us now as Bloomberg
segments.zh: 《华尔街日报》报道，董事会已讨论一项计划，沃尔德伦最早明年与所罗门共同担任。现在请到彭博财经编辑珍妮·苏雷恩。

segments.en: Finance Editor, Jenny Surrain. Jenny, we can talk about the personalities in just a moment.
segments.zh: 珍妮，我们可以稍后讨论他们的个性。

segments.en: But what do you make of the timing that they're discussing?
segments.zh: 但你怎么看他们讨论的时机？

segments.en: The timing, I mean, it's definitely interesting. It's, you know, not such a surprise given.
segments.zh: 时机确实有趣。考虑到之前的情况，并不太意外。

segments.en: We just had last year where Goldman gave him many millions of reasons to stay with the big incentive package that, you know, took place over multiple years.
segments.zh: 去年高盛给了他数百万个留下的理由，提供了多年的大额激励方案。

segments.en: And so I think this is just another sign that, you know, he is the heir apparent.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这只是一个迹象，表明他是明确的接班人。

segments.en: It's even more apparent now. And perhaps a little bit sooner than what some on the street were thinking.
segments.zh: 现在更加明显了，可能比华尔街一些人想的要早一点。

segments.en: How do these men's personality differ? There was a lot made in the early days of Solomon that maybe he was awkward.
segments.zh: 两人的个性有何不同？所罗门早期有很多说法，说他可能有些笨拙。

segments.en: He had to have dinner parties with name tags that the board was kind of concerned about some of these things.
segments.zh: 他不得不参加带姓名牌的晚宴，董事会对此类事情有些担忧。

segments.en: What does John Waldron bring to the table is a potential CEO? I think he's been in the wings for so long that he's not an unknown character, both inside and outside Goldman.
segments.zh: 约翰·沃尔德伦作为潜在CEO能带来什么？我认为他长期处于接班梯队，在高盛内外都不是陌生人物。

segments.en: So this is someone that has had a lot of experience, you know, meeting with staff.
segments.zh: 所以这个人经验丰富，经常与员工交流。

segments.en: He's currently leading the work that they're coining GS3.0.
segments.zh: 他目前领导着他们称为GS3.0的工作。

segments.en: So that's a lot of the works they're doing to kind of adopt AI across Goldman, which gets him really, you know, in the weeds with a lot of the different business units.
segments.zh: 这是他们在高盛全面采用AI所做的大量工作，让他深入接触许多不同业务部门。

segments.en: And then he's definitely a face that folks outside Goldman know that whether that's clients, investors, this is someone who's been groomed for a while for this next job.
segments.zh: 他绝对是高盛外部人士熟悉的面孔，无论是客户还是市场参与者，这个人已经为下一份工作培养了一段时间。
